title: Game-changer for marathon training
text: The heart-rate fabric is shockingly accurate vs my chest strap. Synced instantly to the app.

title: Great shirt, battery ok
text: Comfortable and the data is useful. Wish the battery lasted a full week of runs.

title: Recovery cues actually work
text: The haptic cues after leg day are genuinely helpful. Compression feels premium.

title: Bought for our running club
text: Auto venting is clever. A few members found sizing a touch small.

title: Foot-strike coaching is neat
text: Helped me fix my over-pronation. Sensor placement could be comfier.

title: No chest strap needed
text: Finally accurate HR without a band. Supportive for HIIT.

title: Cushion tracking is smart
text: Knowing when to replace them is great. Auto-lace is gimmicky but fun.

title: Comfortable eco tee
text: Posture nudge is subtle and nice. Ordered 200 for staff uniforms.

title: Best training shorts
text: Heat mapping shows where I overheat. Very breathable.

title: Good idea, early days
text: Rep counting misses some reps on heavy sets. Grip data is interesting.
